title: Chain Stitch on a closed line, entry L1 (23.8, 30), exit L2 (50, 30), Start/End Run
description: A closed straight line (10,10)-(50,10)-(50,30)-(10,30) mm sewn as Chain Stitch at PE-DESIGN's defaults, with the line entry point L1 at (23.8, 30) and the exit point L2 at (50, 30), Start/End Type Run. PE-DESIGN 11.50 keeps every element where it is without the moved points and only changes where the sewing starts and ends: the pattern starts with the link at the exit point L2 and ends with the link before it; Run first sews only the link points from L1's element to there, the shorter way round. Compared: the stitch count, where the needle starts and ends, and the longest stitch.

evidence.note: Start/End Type (Feed, Run) for motif, stem, candlewicking and chain lines whose entry/exit point was changed
docs/COMPATIBILITY_AUDIT.md, Next 11: motif, stem, candlewick and chain lines restart at a moved entry point

references.make: File > New (Design Page 100 x 100 mm, grid 1 mm, Snap to Grid). Shapes > Closed Straight Line: click (10, 10), (50, 10), (50, 30) and double-click (10, 30) mm. Region Not Sewn; line colour 800 RED; line sew type Chain Stitch at the attributes PE-DESIGN shows for the type (triangle, size 4.0, time 5, arrange 1st). With Select > Select Entry/Exit Points drag L1 along the outline to (23.8, 30) mm, between two links of the bottom edge, and L2 round to the corner (50, 30) (PE-DESIGN does not let it up the right edge). In Sewing Attributes > Line sew set Start/End Type Run. Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system, where PE-DESIGN shows L1 and L2, and the status-bar size and stitch count in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).
